name: Renaissance Visionary Thriving Initiative
tagline: Inspiring Innovation, Fostering Growth, Peaceful Harmonious Society
vision: To create a thriving, inclusive society where access to quality education, public health, and sustainable resources empowers every community to achieve their full potential towards a peaceful harmonious society.
mission: Renaissance Visionary Thriving Initiative (RVTI) aims to uplift communities in coastal states and regions in Myanmar through comprehensive programs that enhance educational opportunities, improve public health, and promote sustainable resource governance. We strive to foster self-reliance, resilience, and prosperity among individuals and families.
